results.title: Monroe County Parcels
results.description: File creation date: Sunday, January 3, 2021. This is a vector file that represents tax parcels boundaries in Monroe County, New York. According to § 102. Definitions (of the Real Property Tax Law of New York State):"Parcel" means a separately assessed lot, parcel, piece or portion of real property, except publicly owned bridges and land used for street, road, highway or parkway purposes. A parcel shall not be bisected by a municipal corporation boundary line except that in a special assessing unit a parcel may be bisected by a school district or village boundary line. This layer was created by the Monroe County Department of Environmental Services (DES) GIS division. This layer is recreated weekly and distributed quarterly during the year by DES staff by joining RPS assessment data to the parcel feature class that is maintained daily by the Monroe County Real Property Services Department. The older version of the feature class is archived after a new version has been created.
results.snippet: The purpose of this layer is to define tax parcels within Monroe County, New York. This layer is one of many layers used by the Monroe County Department of Environmental Services (DES) for mapping, geocoding, and querying purposes.

This is a vector file that represents tax parcels boundaries in Monroe County, New York. According to § 102. Definitions (of the Real Property Tax Law of New York State):

"Parcel" means a separately assessed lot, parcel, piece or portion of real property, except publicly owned bridges and land used for street, road, highway or parkway purposes. A parcel shall not be bisected by a municipal corporation boundary line except that in a special assessing unit a parcel may be bisected by a school district or village boundary line.

For more information on parcels, see the "Parcel" feature class in the RPS_Parcels feature dataset that is maintained by the Monroe County Real Property Services (RPS) department from which this layer was created. results.name: Parcel_Boundaries_of_Indiana_Current
results.title: Parcel Boundaries of Indiana Current
results.description: This data layer is an Esri file geodatabase polygon feature class that contains parcel boundaries maintained by county agencies in Indiana. It was released by the Indiana Geographic Information Office (IGIO) on February 1, 2022. The IGIO compiled the data as part of the Indiana Data Harvest program between the Indiana Geographic Information Council (IGIC) and all Indiana counties to provide the most accurate framework data for the citizens of Indiana. These layers include address points, street centerlines, land parcels, and governmental boundaries.
results.snippet:
This dataset was developed to provide accurate parcel boundaries for Indiana, as part of Indiana's annual GIS Data harvest Data Sharing Initiative (IDSI) of the Indiana Geographic Information Office (IGIO).

If attempting to download this data in shapefile or file geodatabase format on indianamap.org, please note that this dataset is too large to fit in a shapefile and generating a geodatabase does not perform well in the ArcGIS Hub interface. To download a pre-zipped file geodatabase, please go to https://countydataharvest.in.gov/statewide/2022/DataHarvest_2022_SingleFGDB_20230125.zip.
results.accessInformation: This data set was created as part of the Indiana Geographic Information Office's GIS Data Harvest Program. The source data used to create this dataset was provided by Indiana counties.

results.title: New Valmeyer Parcel Information
results.description:
This feature class attaches mean, maximum and minimum slope and distance to old Valmeyer, averaged per parcel. The slope raster was derived from a 10 meter elevation DEM of Monroe County using the slope geoprocessing tool. From there, geoprocessing tool Zonal Statistics as Table was used to find the minimum, maximum and mean slope for each parcel. These were then joined to the parcels by the shared PARCEL_NUM attribute using the Join Field tool. The same workflow was used on the elevation DEM to arrive at the same summary statistics.

The mean distance from the old location of the town used the distance accumulation geoprocessing tool, then found the mean distance per parcel using the same Zonal Statistics as Table tool, and the Join Field tool along the same attribute.

Based on parcel data of Monroe County, subset to the new and old locations of Valmeyer, from Tim Kropp at SIU, received by UC Davis in 2015, and DEM elevation data for the county also provided by UC Davis. The workflow described above was carried out by Jan Low in July 2025.
results.snippet: This feature class contains the following attributes: mean, maximum and minimum slope and elevation, as well as mean distance from the old location of Valmeyer, per parcel in New Valmeyer.
